reason: Checked the evidence and could not refute it. (1) The coupling is real: tools/build_probe_kernel.py l.1652 reads _LOWREFINE_MIN_SCORE from BIOHUB_READMIT_MIN_SCORE. (2) The dummy-log numbers are exact. exp70g LOWREFINE refined 26,532/33,336/7,370/76,396 (>=0.965) and exp85c 26,694/36,487/7,497/77,342 (>=0.94), +4,386; exp85a is identical to 85c; failed frames 0 on every clip. Readmits went from 96/677/84/508 = 1,365 to 167/1,148/105/804 = 2,224. (3) My own KD-tree recompute on the two dummy submission.csv files: 2,913 nodes are new at a 0.5-voxel cut (the finding's 1-um cut gives 1,857). 7.96% of them sit on the 4-px xy grid, against 7.44% of all exp70g nodes. Unrefined rows would be ~100% on the grid, so the band readmits do carry head coordinates, as claimed. (4) Size: going from grid to head coordinates moves a node by at most ~1.15 um in xy, against a ~7 um match radius. The only public read of lowrefine was display-neutral (#38 = 0.953 = #34), and that covered ~143k refined peaks; the band adds ~4.4k more. So the coordinate part of exp85a/85c is second-order next to the +1,022-node READMIT volume change (1,857 new / 835 lost churn). Decoupling would only put the band readmits back on the coarse 1.625 um grid, with no public or lab reason to prefer that. (5) Feasibility: no build, no submit, no slot, no R1-R10 impact; lowrefine stays fail-soft (grid coordinates kept on exception). Residual caveats, which do not overturn the verdict: 'better localisation' in the 0.94-0.965 band is asserted, not measured against GT. The 0.92 case (exp86c) is extrapolated because its dummy has not run. Coordinate moves can nudge relink/safe-division geometry (e.g. the +1 insertion on 44b6_0b24845f), which cannot be separated from volume but is tiny. 'Read 50/exp85c as node-volume reads' is accurate as 'readmit-band reads (volume plus K2 coordinates)'.
fix: Adopt as proposed, with two small additions. (a) The CONTEXT amendment should read: 'lowrefine part benign and coherent: band readmits get head coordinates; +4,386 refined peaks, 0 failed frames; lowrefine alone display-neutral (#38); read 50/exp85c as readmit-band reads; no decoupling build'. (b) The dummy gate for every READMIT-rung file (exp86a/86b/86c) must check 'failed frames 0' on all 4 LOWREFINE lines and log refined R of N, the readmitted counts, and node churn new/lost/moved next to the net change. For exp86c (0.92), expect refined counts only slightly above exp85a's 148,020; any 'LOWREFINE FAILED' line or a refined-count jump above ~+5% over exp85a means the 0.92 extrapolation is void, and that file is held until inspected. Do not use 'two changes' to explain a '-' on probe 50.
realistic_gain: 0 LB directly: this is a bookkeeping and attribution correction. It avoids a wasted decoupling build (~25 GPU-min dummy plus build time) and a misread of probe 50/exp85c/exp86c, and it adds a cheap gate check for the READMIT ladder.
